items.title: News (NWSA) Stock Looks Above Fair Value As Earnings Beat Lifts Shares
items.summary: News stock has delivered a strong 47.8% gain over the past three years, yet the current valuation checks suggest the shares lean expensive rather than offering obvious value. Investors are weighing that solid medium term return against signals that the stock does not screen as a clear bargain on standard metrics. items.title: Maria Bartiromo Out at Fox News
items.summary: Fox News has parted ways with longtime anchor  Maria Bartiromo.  The journalist is no longer with Fox News Media, effective Thursday, the network said in a news release.  Bartiromo, 58, hadn’t been on Fox News or Fox Business for almost a month.

items.title: DIS Is Priced Like The Best Of Its Group. Is It?
items.summary: The market is charging a premium for Walt Disney stock, but its growth and profit metrics currently trail key rivals. Is this a bet on a magical future, or just a storybook valuation.

items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks That Fall Short
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

items.title: The Hidden Engine That Could Drive Walt Disney Stock Higher
items.summary: The debate over parks and box office hits is missing the real story: Disney's streaming business has finally turned into a profit machine.

items.title: Walt Disney Stock's Next Leg Depends On What It Has Been Building
items.summary: New park and cruise capacity is filling up while guests spend more per visit, and that pairing is the clearest upside case for Walt Disney stock.

items.title: Rupert Murdoch Made A Simple Mistake When Constructing His Trust. It Cost Him $3.3 Billion to Fix. Here’s What Estate Planners Say You Should Do Instead.
items.summary: A single architectural flaw buried inside a 25-year-old family trust set off a legal battle that nearly tore the Murdoch empire apart, and the fix that finally ended it offers a cautionary lesson for anyone who thinks a signed trust document is the same as a finished plan.

items.title: Does Fox (FOXA) Boosting Dividends Amid Softer Earnings Hint At A Shifting Capital Strategy?
items.summary: Fox Corporation recently reported past fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 results, with quarterly sales rising to US$4,212 million while net income eased to US$691 million, and also filed a universal shelf registration covering multiple classes of stock and debt. Alongside these mixed earnings, Fox’s board approved a higher semi-annual dividend of US$0.29 per share, signaling ongoing commitment to shareholder income even as full-year net income and earnings per share declined.
